eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Eagle, CO; at 7:41 PM on AUG 18, 2025 Effective until 7:41 PM AUG 19, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Wildland fire crews are on scene at the Derby Fire. Pre-evacuations are in place for Derby Mesa, Sweetwater, and areas of northwest Eagle County. There is no imminent threat to life safety or homes at this time. Residents of the area should be prepared if evacuations become necessary. Monitor ECEMO.ORG for more information
